Lindqvist Optik is a one-room opticians in Malmö: eye exams without upselling, frames without logos, and lenses ground for the way you actually look at the world.
Round, patient, looks better on you than you expect.
Rectangular, decisive, the one architects buy.
Browline, slightly dramatic, for people with opinions.
Every frame in every size, tinted or clear, with your prescription ground in-house. If none of the three suit you, we will say so and point you elsewhere.
